HediffDef.label: acid protocol
HediffDef.description: A protected elite-raider kill-switch protocol. If implant extraction is attempted before the protocol is disabled, the pawn's protected body systems are intended to be destroyed.

HediffDef.label: explosive protocol
HediffDef.description: A protected elite-raider kill-switch protocol. If implant extraction is attempted before the protocol is disabled, the pawn's protected body systems are intended to detonate and destroy recoverable implants.
